row.name: Charles River Laboratories International Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=25 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=1 giveback=0.27 tightness=0.83 base_volume_vs_leg=1.03 base_volume_vs_avg=0.98
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 25 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 9.2% vs its 20-SMA, 7.7% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 3 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The VOL check is a recorded FAIL because the base exceeds 21 sessions and volume at 1.4x the 50-session average falls short of the required 1.5x catalyst threshold, which is the single most decisive measured defect. The base itself is 25 sessions — outside Bonde's 3–20 window — and the chart shows the shaded consolidation region spanning roughly August 28 through early October with several wide overlapping red and green bars, confirming the PARTIAL C. The prior leg is genuinely linear (R2=0.90) and the signal bar closed near its high with honest range expansion, so the chart does not add further disqualifying flaws.
claude.key_risk: A long base with a burst-in-base and volume that fails the catalyst threshold for extended consolidations means follow-through is less reliable than a clean A+ setup.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the signal close of 310.77 by more than 1%, or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back below the prior base high near 303.
